sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording; refer Policy Schedule

room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction applies if higher room category is taken. ICU charges exempt from proportionate deduction.

icu.note: ICU charges covered; proportionate deductions not applicable for ICU.

copayment.display: Mandatory co-pay as per Policy Schedule (waivable via optional add-on); zone-based co-pay applies
copayment.note: Mandatory co-payment percentage specified in Policy Schedule; waiver available as optional cover. Zone-based co-pay: 10%/15%/25% for treatment in higher zone.

sub_limits.note: Sub-limits on specific diseases apply only to Platinum Essential plan; Enhanced plan does not carry the same disease-wise sub-limits per wording.

maternity.note: Maternity Expenses available as optional cover with 48-month waiting period; up to ₹75,000 (normal) or ₹1,00,000 (C-section) per event, max 2 events.

cumulative_bonus.note: Accrues on claim-free years; max 100% of SI. HealthReturns up to 100% of premium (excl. optional covers).

restoration.note: Super Reload available: unlimited reloads during Policy Year for any illness/injury including same illness. Each reload capped at base SI.

domiciliary.note: Minimum 3 consecutive days; certain conditions excluded.

ambulance.display: Covered up to limits in Policy Schedule

consumables.note: Non-medical consumables excluded; HealthReturns can be used for non-payable items.

global_cover.note: International Coverage for Major Illnesses available as optional cover (Section C.V.36) for Enhanced plan.

notable_exclusions: Parkinson's/Alzheimer's, sleep apnea, alopecia, hearing aids/spectacles, dental (non-accident), IVF/ART, non-allopathic (except AYUSH inbuilt), cosmetic surgery
optional_riders: Waiver of Mandatory Co-pay, Maternity Expenses, OPD Expenses, Hospital Cash, Personal Accident (AD/PTD), Critical Illness Cover, International Coverage for Major Illnesses, PPN Discount, Surrogacy/Oocyte complications
insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
